name: Rivaaj Mahal Herbal Hair Oil 100% | 20+ Herbs for Strong & Healthy Hair
description:
Rivaaj Mahal Herbal Hair Oil is a 100% natural blend of 20+ herbs designed to nourish hair from roots to tips. It strengthens hair, reduces breakage, promotes natural growth, and restores softness and shine. Free from harsh chemicals, this herbal oil is safe for daily use on all hair types and helps combat dandruff, dryness, and scalp irritation. Suitable for both men and women, it delivers healthier, thicker, and more vibrant hair naturally.
Key Features
 100% herbal formula with 20+ natural herbs
 Strengthens roots and reduces hair fall
 Promotes long, thick, and healthy hair growth
 Nourishes scalp and controls dandruff and dryness
 Adds natural shine, softness, and silkiness
 Chemical-free and safe for all hair types
How to Use
 Apply to scalp and hair generously
 Massage gently for 5–10 minutes
 Leave for 1–2 hours or overnight for best results
 Wash with mild shampoo
Material
20+ natural herbs and carrier oils
Safety Information
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes
 Keep out of reach of children
 Discontinue if irritation occurs
Package Includes
 1 × 100% Rivaaj Mahal Herbal Hair Oil
